name: price-target-fan
title: Price Target Fan
description: Compare price forecasts around a shared origin using projected target paths.

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import { usePriceTargetFan } from "./context";
import { fmtAxisDate, H, PAD } from "./utils";
const chart = usePriceTargetFan();
const labels = computed(() => {
  const dates: { x: number; text: string; anchor: string }[] = [];
  if (chart.history.length)
    dates.push({
      x: chart.geo.hx(0),
      text: chart.dates.start ?? fmtAxisDate(chart.history[0].date),
      anchor: "start",
    });
  if (chart.history.length > 2) {
    const index = Math.floor(chart.history.length / 2);
    dates.push({
      x: chart.geo.hx(index),
      text: chart.dates.mid ?? fmtAxisDate(chart.history[index].date),
      anchor: "middle",
    });
  }
  dates.push(
    { x: chart.geo.nowX, text: "Now", anchor: "middle" },
    {
      x: chart.geo.endX,
      text: chart.dates.horizon ?? "Target",
      anchor: "middle",
    },
  );
  return dates;
});
</script>
<template>
  <g
    ><g v-for="value in chart.gridVals.out" :key="value"
      ><line
        :x1="PAD.l"
        :y1="chart.y(value)"
        :x2="chart.geo.endX"
        :y2="chart.y(value)"
        stroke="var(--border)"
        stroke-dasharray="2 5"
      /><text
        :x="PAD.l - 8"
        :y="chart.y(value) + 3"
        text-anchor="end"
        font-size="9"
        fill="var(--muted-foreground)"
        class="font-mono tabular-nums"
        >{{
          chart.gridVals.step >= 1 ? Math.round(value) : value.toFixed(1)
        }}</text
      ></g
    ><text
      v-for="label in labels"
      :key="label.x"
      :x="label.x"
      :y="H - 8"
      :text-anchor="label.anchor"
      font-size="9"
      fill="var(--muted-foreground)"
      class="font-mono"
      >{{ label.text }}</text
    ><line
      :x1="chart.geo.nowX"
      :y1="PAD.t"
      :x2="chart.geo.nowX"
      :y2="H - PAD.b"
      :stroke="`url(#${chart.fadeId})`"
      stroke-width="1"
      stroke-dasharray="3 3"
  /></g>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { motion } from "motion-v";
import { SPRING_GLIDE } from "../../../lib/ease";
import { usePriceTargetFan } from "./context";
import { H, PAD } from "./utils";
const chart = usePriceTargetFan();
</script>
<template>
  <g
    ><g v-if="chart.scrub !== null" pointer-events="none"
      ><motion.line
        :y1="PAD.t"
        :y2="H - PAD.b"
        :stroke="`url(#${chart.fadeId})`"
        stroke-width="1"
        :initial="false"
        :animate="{
          x1: chart.geo.hx(chart.scrub),
          x2: chart.geo.hx(chart.scrub),
        }"
        :transition="
          chart.reduce ? { duration: 0 } : { type: 'spring', ...SPRING_GLIDE }
        " /><motion.circle
        r="3.2"
        fill="var(--foreground)"
        stroke="var(--background)"
        stroke-width="1.5"
        :initial="false"
        :animate="{
          cx: chart.geo.hx(chart.scrub),
          cy: chart.y(chart.hist[chart.scrub]),
        }"
        :transition="
          chart.reduce ? { duration: 0 } : { type: 'spring', ...SPRING_GLIDE }
        " /></g
  ></g>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import { motion } from "motion-v";
import { EASE_OUT } from "../../../lib/ease";
import { usePriceTargetFan } from "./context";
const chart = usePriceTargetFan();
const selected = computed(() => chart.scrub ?? chart.hist.length - 1);
function keydown(event: KeyboardEvent) {
  if (event.key === "Escape") {
    event.preventDefault();
    chart.setActive(null);
    return;
  }
  const destinations: Record<string, number> = {
    Home: 0,
    End: chart.hist.length - 1,
    ArrowLeft: selected.value - 1,
    ArrowRight: selected.value + 1,
  };
  if (!(event.key in destinations)) return;
  event.preventDefault();
  chart.setScrub(
    Math.max(0, Math.min(chart.hist.length - 1, destinations[event.key])),
  );
}
</script>
<template>
  <g
    ><g
      v-if="chart.hist.length"
      role="slider"
      tabindex="0"
      aria-label="Price history"
      :aria-valuemin="0"
      :aria-valuemax="chart.hist.length - 1"
      :aria-valuenow="selected"
      :aria-valuetext="`${chart.history[selected].date}: ${chart.fmt(chart.hist[selected])}`"
      :aria-describedby="chart.scrub !== null ? chart.tooltipId : undefined"
      @focus="chart.setScrub(chart.hist.length - 1)"
      @blur="chart.setActive(null)"
      @keydown="keydown"
      ><motion.path
        data-price-history=""
        :d="chart.geo.line"
        fill="none"
        stroke="var(--foreground)"
        stroke-width="1.5"
        stroke-linecap="round"
        :initial="{ pathLength: chart.reduce ? 1 : 0 }"
        :animate="{ pathLength: 1 }"
        :transition="
          chart.reduce ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.9, ease: EASE_OUT }
        " /></g
  ></g>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import { motion } from "motion-v";
import { EASE_OUT, SPRING_PANEL } from "../../../lib/ease";
import { usePriceTargetFan } from "./context";
const chart = usePriceTargetFan();
const origin = computed(() => ({
  transformOrigin: `${chart.geo.nowX}px ${chart.geo.nowY}px`,
}));
</script>
<template>
  <g
    ><motion.circle
      :cx="chart.geo.nowX"
      :cy="chart.geo.nowY"
      r="3.2"
      fill="var(--foreground)"
      :initial="{ opacity: chart.reduce ? 1 : 0, scale: chart.reduce ? 1 : 0 }"
      :animate="{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }"
      :transition="
        chart.reduce ? { duration: 0 } : { ...SPRING_PANEL, delay: 0.85 }
      "
      :style="origin" /><motion.circle
      v-if="!chart.reduce"
      :cx="chart.geo.nowX"
      :cy="chart.geo.nowY"
      r="3.2"
      fill="none"
      stroke="var(--foreground)"
      stroke-width="1"
      :initial="{ opacity: 0, scale: 1 }"
      :animate="{ opacity: [0.45, 0], scale: [1, 2.8] }"
      :transition="{
        duration: 2.2,
        ease: EASE_OUT,
        repeat: Infinity,
        repeatDelay: 1.6,
        delay: 1.6,
      }"
      :style="origin"
  /></g>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { h, mergeProps, renderSlot, useAttrs } from "vue";
import PriceTargetFanSvg from "./PriceTargetFanSvg.vue";
import PriceTargetFanTooltip from "./PriceTargetFanTooltip.vue";
defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false });
const slots = defineSlots<{ default?(props: {}): any }>();
const attrs = useAttrs();
const builtInLayers = [PriceTargetFanSvg, PriceTargetFanTooltip] as const;
const RenderFrame = () =>
  h("div", mergeProps({ class: "relative" }, attrs), [
    renderSlot(slots, "default", {}, () =>
      builtInLayers.map((layer) => h(layer)),
    ),
  ]);
</script>
<template><RenderFrame /></template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref } from "vue";
import { motion } from "motion-v";
import { EASE_OUT } from "../../../lib/ease";
import { usePriceTargetFan } from "./context";
import { H, PAD, W } from "./utils";
import PriceTargetFanAxes from "./PriceTargetFanAxes.vue";
import PriceTargetFanHistory from "./PriceTargetFanHistory.vue";
import PriceTargetFanTargets from "./PriceTargetFanTargets.vue";
import PriceTargetFanNow from "./PriceTargetFanNow.vue";
import PriceTargetFanCursor from "./PriceTargetFanCursor.vue";
const chart = usePriceTargetFan(),
  element = ref<SVGSVGElement | null>(null);
onMounted(() => {
  chart.svgRef.value = element.value;
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
  if (chart.svgRef.value === element.value) chart.svgRef.value = null;
});
</script>
<template>
  <svg
    ref="element"
    :viewBox="`0 0 ${W} ${H}`"
    class="block h-auto w-full cursor-crosshair [&_*]:cursor-crosshair"
    role="group"
    :aria-label="`${chart.label}: mean ${chart.fmt(chart.mean.price)}, now ${chart.fmt(chart.current)}`"
    @pointermove="chart.onMove"
    @pointerleave="$event.pointerType !== 'touch' && chart.setActive(null)"
  >
    <defs>
      <linearGradient
        :id="chart.fadeId"
        gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse"
        x1="0"
        :y1="PAD.t"
        x2="0"
        :y2="H - PAD.b"
      >
        <stop offset="0" stop-color="var(--border-strong)" stop-opacity="0" />
        <stop offset=".45" stop-color="var(--border-strong)" stop-opacity="1" />
        <stop offset="1" stop-color="var(--border-strong)" stop-opacity="1" />
      </linearGradient>
      <clipPath :id="chart.clipId">
        <motion.rect
          :x="chart.geo.nowX"
          y="0"
          :height="H"
          :initial="{ width: chart.reduce ? W - chart.geo.nowX : 0 }"
          :animate="{ width: W - chart.geo.nowX }"
          :transition="
            chart.reduce
              ? { duration: 0 }
              : { duration: 0.8, ease: EASE_OUT, delay: 0.85 }
          "
        />
      </clipPath>
    </defs>
    <slot>
      <PriceTargetFanAxes />
      <PriceTargetFanHistory />
      <PriceTargetFanTargets />
      <PriceTargetFanNow />
      <PriceTargetFanCursor />
    </slot>
  </svg>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { motion } from "motion-v";
import { EASE_OUT, SPRING_PANEL } from "../../../lib/ease";
import { usePriceTargetFan } from "./context";
import { ink } from "./utils";
const chart = usePriceTargetFan();
function toggle(index: number) {
  chart.setHotT(chart.hotT === index ? null : index);
}
function touch(event: PointerEvent, index: number) {
  if (event.pointerType === "touch") {
    event.preventDefault();
    toggle(index);
  }
}
function keydown(event: KeyboardEvent, index: number) {
  if (event.key === "Escape") {
    event.preventDefault();
    chart.setActive(null);
  } else if (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ") {
    event.preventDefault();
    toggle(index);
  }
}
</script>
<template>
  <g
    ><g :clip-path="`url(#${chart.clipId})`"
      ><motion.g
        v-for="(target, index) in chart.geo.proj"
        :key="target.key"
        role="button"
        tabindex="0"
        :aria-label="`${target.key} target ${chart.fmt(target.price)}, ${target.analysts} analysts`"
        class="outline-none"
        :aria-pressed="chart.hotT === index"
        :aria-describedby="chart.hotT === index ? chart.tooltipId : undefined"
        :initial="{ opacity: 1 }"
        :animate="{
          opacity: chart.hotT !== null && chart.hotT !== index ? 0.3 : 1,
        }"
        :transition="
          chart.reduce ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.25, ease: EASE_OUT }
        "
        @focus="chart.setHotT(index)"
        @blur="chart.setHotT(null)"
        @pointerenter="chart.setHotT(index)"
        @pointerdown="touch($event, index)"
        @keydown="keydown($event, index)"
        ><path
          :d="target.d"
          fill="none"
          stroke="transparent"
          stroke-width="16"
        /><path
          :d="target.d"
          fill="none"
          :stroke="target.color"
          :stroke-width="chart.hotT === index ? 2.2 : 1.4"
          :stroke-opacity="chart.hotT === index ? 1 : 0.75"
          stroke-dasharray="2 4"
          stroke-linecap="round"
        /><motion.path
          v-if="chart.hotT === index"
          :d="target.d"
          fill="none"
          :stroke="target.color"
          stroke-width="2.2"
          stroke-linecap="round"
          :initial="{ pathLength: chart.reduce ? 1 : 0 }"
          :animate="{ pathLength: 1 }"
          :transition="
            chart.reduce ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.35, ease: EASE_OUT }
          "
        /><motion.circle
          :cx="chart.geo.endX"
          :cy="target.ty"
          fill="var(--background)"
          :stroke="target.color"
          stroke-width="1.6"
          r="3.2"
          :animate="{ r: chart.hotT === index ? 4.5 : 3.2 }"
          :transition="chart.reduce ? { duration: 0 } : SPRING_PANEL"
        /><text
          :x="chart.geo.endX + 10"
          :y="target.ty + 4"
          font-size="11"
          font-weight="600"
          :fill="ink(target.color)"
          class="font-mono tabular-nums"
          >{{ target.price }}</text
        ></motion.g
      ></g
    ></g
  >
</template>
